preservationRule: all predecessor responsibilities remain required; this delta relocates no security responsibility to a caller fact

v2Responsibilities.statement: Every admitted role maps to exactly NONE or STATE_MUTABLE_NFT_ZERO; arbitrary CashToken classification is not admitted.
Network is one manifest label and not dynamic transaction identity; identical-history chain replay remains explicit.
Each state/carrier script checks its own OP_INPUTINDEX against an embedded fixed role; no evaluation-site state enters the shared view.
N>=1 full carrier unlocking bytecodes, including every push opcode and redeem byte, are ordered, parsed, and consumed in one session.
Deployment, context, carrier-session, envelope, and session digests are rebuilt from raw binary inputs and are never caller authority.
Structural template/compiler/genesis evidence and its root are off-chain only; no provenance object is a runtime relation input.
The fixture compiler emits redeem scripts ending OP_FALSE and cannot establish deployment, standardness, VM acceptance, or verifier credit.
